## Summary

An industrial-era city builder in which residents advance through five Old World tiers by consuming goods from multi-island production chains, linked to a New World session by trade routes and contested by AI rivals.

## Core Loop

settle an island and house farmers -> meet tier needs with production chains -> houses advance to workers, artisans, engineers, and investors -> higher tiers need goods from other islands and the New World -> build ships and trade routes -> expand under rival pressure

## Design Notes

Demand is generated by population tiers: basic needs raise how many residents a house holds, luxury needs raise taxes and happiness, and a house advances only when full, supplied, and given construction materials, so each new tier opens a new set of chains. Each tier also staffs its own buildings, so advancing workers to artisans removes labor from worker-tier factories. Old World cities depend on goods from a parallel New World session, so ship routes between sessions are a logistics layer on top of island production.

## Relations

**uses**

- [Population strata](../mechanic/population-strata.md) (core): Old World tiers Farmers, Workers, Artisans, Engineers, Investors and New World Jornaleros and Obreros; a house advances when full, its basic needs met, and materials available.
- [Goods consumption](../mechanic/goods-consumption.md) (core): Each residence consumes goods per second; basic needs add inhabitants per house, luxury needs add taxes and happiness.
- [Production chains](../mechanic/production-chain.md) (core): Fixed-recipe buildings chain raw materials into goods; many chains span islands and both sessions.
- [Trade routes](../mechanic/trade-routes.md) (core): Ships carry goods between the player's islands, the New World session, and traders.
- [Vehicle routes and schedules](../mechanic/vehicle-route-scheduling.md) (supporting): Trade route ships follow ordered stops with load and unload amounts per good.
- [Labor market](../mechanic/labor-market.md) (supporting): Each tier staffs only its tier's production buildings.
- [Storage and buffers](../mechanic/storage-capacity.md) (supporting): Warehouses set island storage limits and pickup range.
- [Rival firms](../mechanic/rival-firms.md) (supporting): AI opponents settle the same map and compete for islands and trade.
- [Milestone unlocks](../mechanic/milestone-unlocks.md) (supporting): Reaching population thresholds of each tier unlocks buildings.
- [Blueprints](../mechanic/blueprints.md) (supporting): Blueprint mode places silhouettes that are built later with one click when resources exist.
- [Megaproject sink](../mechanic/megaproject-sink.md) (supporting): The World's Fair monument is built in stages, each consuming large deliveries of goods, and once complete hosts exhibitions.
